title: Union agri minister, Andhra CM launch VB-G RAM G
description: Union agriculture and rural development minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan on Thursday launched the Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission-Gramin (VB-G RAM G), the flagship programme of the NDA government at the Centre, at Railway Koduru in Andhra Pradesh’s Tirupati district
